original_benchmark.notes: AgentDojo v1.2.2 (agentdojo==0.1.35): 97 user tasks across the workspace (40), travel (20), banking (16) and slack (21) suites, run without injections. Upstream runs models through its own tool-calling pipeline (system message, tool execution loop); utility is a deterministic check of the final answer, environment and tool calls.

Every user task x injection task pair of a suite (560 + 140 + 144 + 105), with the injections of a registered attack placed in the environment. Utility and security (injection task succeeded) are deterministic checks.

harbor_adapter.notes: Local parity completed 2026-11-26, three runs per side, matching run ranges on all reported metrics. Clean utility 100% on both sides. Ten tasks in this split; ceiling/floor scores limit broader conclusions. Separate Codex 0.118.0 generalization run on 20 tasks: clean/attacked utility 100%, ASR 0%, zero exceptions. Native runner published; dataset registration submitted as harbor-datasets#313. Sanitized artifacts are published at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Catherine1213/agentdojo-parity-experiments/tree/b866de430b5e256cce9adcd029c6d264abd2eedf/adapters/agentdojo, with remote hash verification and exact aggregate recomputation. Official parity PR #318 links this revision because the shared repository is full. Dataset registry publication remains pending.
